name: ?jqAddBatch@@YAHABUjqBatch@@@Z
detail: Release jqBatch is the 0x38-byte descriptor with Input/Output/Scratch/Static pointers, four size fields, Handle at +0x20, Module at +0x24, Priority at +0x28, GroupID at +0x2C, and Next at +0x30; jobqueue.cpp now uses that shared definition and copies/enqueues the matching fields.
